title: Game Contents
pages:
Bestiary and Charms
Track creatures in the Bestiary, earn charm points and assign charms from the Cyclopedia.

Item Cyclopedia
Browse items, compare stats and inspect equipment without leaving the client.

Prey and Task Board
Use the Prey dialog to hunt selected creatures for bonus loot and experience. Open the Task Board for hunting tasks and rewards where your world supports them.

Market and Depot
Trade through the Market window. Store items in your depot chest and manage inboxes from town depots.

title: Client Features
pages:
Cyclopedia
Open the Cyclopedia from the side panel for Bestiary, Bosstiary, Charms, Map, Houses, Items, Character overview and Magical Archive (spells).

Magical Archive
Search spells and runes, read combat stats and assign spells directly to your action bars.

Control Buttons
Right-click the shortcut sidebar and choose Manage Control Buttons to show, hide and reorder panel icons.

Client Help
Use Lens Help to highlight interface areas and read short explanations while you play.

title: Useful Info
pages:
Hotkeys and Action Bars
Configure hotkeys in Options. Drag spells, items and text to action bars for quick use in combat.

Quest Log
Track active quests and pin objectives with the Quest Tracker from the quest log window.

title: Major Updates
pages:
Modern Client Systems
This client integrates Cyclopedia tabs, Weapon Proficiency, Wheel of Destiny, Exaltation Forge, Reward Wall and other Tibia-style systems supported by your OT server.

Content in this Compendium can be extended by editing compendium_pages.json in the game_compendium module.

title: Support
pages: Gameplay issues are handled by your game server staff. For client bugs, note your client version, steps to reproduce and attach screenshots when reporting to your server's support channel.
